candidates.title: Move only P1 epoch-ticket allocation off the W/X launch prologue
candidates.mechanism: For the existing selected z/x P1 instances, move the even-word atomicAdd ticket allocation from the prologue to immediately before its first epoch/acquire wait. Keep the zeroer, odd-word release publication, acquire poll, bounded trap, reduction, S and grid unchanged. On a single ordered CUDA stream each completed launch still consumes exactly S tickets/tile and one flag increment; prove this rather than reset counters.
candidates.why_current: Actual scored router8 is x/S16, router16 z/S16, router32 z/S8; unpooler1/8 use x/S4. The matched PW38 router8 SASS has ticket ATOMG at0x350 before X/W LDG0x410/0x460 and later acquire waits. Static PC order is not timing proof; this is a placement experiment, not an atomic-count reduction.
candidates.cpu_discriminator: State-machine proof for arbitrary CTA arrival order and repeated graph launches, source-bound physical alias/counter transitions, then one new compile-time placement bit at fixed selected geometries. Explicitly model unsupported concurrent-state streams and hold them rather than assume one epoch.
candidates.falsifier: Ticket issue already overlaps all useful work, moving it delays the final acquire critical path, any epoch/alias test fails, or paired complete-kernel delta loses. Old midstream flag-prefetch no-gain evidence is not counted as support.
candidates.new_proof: Exact per-launch counter deltas and zero-before-reduction ordering must remain identical. No speculative output, removed acquire, extra graph node or host-maintained replay epoch.

candidates.title: Weight-derived empty-escape specialization on current QKV GV1/GV8
candidates.mechanism: At entry, use the existing warp-uniform first escape sentinel to choose a templated escape-free step loop or the exact old escape loop. Empty-list warps execute identical12-bit decode/MMA/load ordering without the per-unit next-sequence test; nonempty lists preserve every correction. Do not change geometry, W depth, cache policy or arithmetic. Existing SASS already interleaves dec1 operations, so merely reordering four dec1 calls is NOT the proposal.
candidates.why_current: Scored QKV1 is GV(1,1,1,2,16,8,1,1,2,1),64registers; QKV8 is GV(1,1,1,1,16,8,1,1,2,8193). Current _gvesc emits32-entry sentinel lists; step checks nx on every K-unit. Exact CUDA empty-list prevalence is not archived and is the first discriminator.
candidates.cpu_discriminator: Prove sentinel-uniform branch and identical corrections/math for both paths, including adversarial nonempty escapes and odd M. Compile only these two existing geometries; reject if64-register/two-CTA eligibility is lost or instruction-cache expansion removes the saved path. Count actual prepared empty lists in the next authorized trial before timing.
candidates.falsifier: Actual empty lists are rare, generated SASS already hoists the test equivalently, resource/code-size cost dominates, or complete current-policy F1 and paired signed deltas do not improve. Keep every small signed observation.
candidates.new_proof: No escape may be omitted based on sampled frequency; sentinel is exact weight-derived metadata. Both warp paths rendezvous through the existing CTA reduction unchanged.

candidates.title: Replace Lt256 fixed1% rejection with bounded held-out finalist confirmation
candidates.mechanism: Keep existing algorithms/layout/workspace/correctness inventory; change only final selection. Within unchanged22s aggregate Lt budget, compare torch default and at most two already-legal leaders in randomized paired brackets on fresh held-out fixtures. Replace the fixed best>torch*0.99 discard rule with a source-frozen no-forced-pick decision that preserves every raw tiny delta and validates selection regret separately.
candidates.why_current: All four BF16 M256 routes are vendor kernels in the scored job, not RQ. _ltsearch already enumerates all four layouts and seeded refinements; a new o32/layout2 sweep is not proposed. It retimes leaders while lowering t_torch by a minimum, then applies1% rejection. Scored stdout is truncated and selected Lt config IDs are not recovered; capture actual selected/default configurations before testing.
candidates.cpu_discriminator: Host-only legality and configuration read-back, beta0/FP32 accumulation/workspace proofs, no data-dependent output caching, fixed global budget and independent decision/held-out seed sets. Reuse PW39 selection lesson, but do not duplicate its already-completed RQ confirmation run.
candidates.falsifier: No actual near-margin legal finalist exists, unbiased confirmation selects default with no held-out improvement, budget wall time grows or correctness fails. A particular small signed delta is not automatically dropped or called significant.
candidates.new_proof: Vendor SASS is not collected here; current scored actual vendor symbols are the route evidence. Unknown exact selected config stays null; no alternative is forced or selected by output values.

candidates.title: Decouple selected EH warpgroup epilogues with separate output slabs
candidates.mechanism: Keep selected EH ordering but allocate two dedicated16KiB output slabs outside live X/W rings. Compare (a)current reused-Xring EH, (b)dedicated slabs with old256-thread retirement barrier, (c)same dedicated slabs with only per-WG final-wait0 and128-thread slab rendezvous. The proposed gain is avoiding waiting for the other WG before its epilogue, not deleting per-WG WGMMA retirement or proxy publication.
candidates.why_current: PW38 qkv128 FL65539 and pooler128 FL65538 are actually selected. Current local-JIT EH has final WGMMA wait0 at0x3290,256-thread bar1 at0x3480, first STSM0x3550, then first TMA reduction0x3750. That cross-WG barrier protects reused Xring storage; it cannot simply be removed. Dedicated32768extra shared bytes are an explicit resource confound.
candidates.cpu_discriminator: First prove disjoint dedicated slabs, producer drain and per-WG retirement for all ragged KS7/KS4 partitions. Freeze resource-control arm(b) before testing scheduling arm(c); require actual opt-in occupancy and zeroer co-residency. Historical EP early-poll had no gain and is deliberately NOT retried.
candidates.falsifier: Warpgroup completion is already balanced, extra32KiB prevents required occupancy/co-residency, equal-resource barrier removal is neutral/losing, or any X/W/output lifetime proof fails.
candidates.new_proof: This new lifetime topology has the largest unknown CPU proof cost. Do not treat source deletion of bar1 as safe or infer benefit from the SASS gap.

candidates.title: HALF+EARLY full-K plain-store o32, against its actual ST6/KS2 RQ
candidates.mechanism: Add one narrowly legal NT32/ST5/HALF+plain-store+EARLY instantiation (FL52, optional separately labelled HINT53) at KS1. Reuse the existing HALF and EARLY source paths rather than create a native-X prototype. N8192 gives2*NB=128 64-row CTAs, comparable grid count to current64*KS2=128; remove the current cross-CTA output zero/poll/reduce protocol by writing disjoint output tiles.
candidates.why_current: PW38 o32 actually serves rq<32,6,...,35>,KS2. RQV contains older h32s8/full-K controls and a successful-context h128s8e source alternative, but RQSBAKE never offers a shallow h32s5e. This is a new shallow-half/startup composition, not a claim old full-K/HALF losses disappeared. QKV16/32 remain unchanged controls; do not extrapolate to their much smaller grid.
candidates.cpu_discriminator: Prove all8192x1024 W and32x8192 output tiles exactly once, full-K escape grouping and HALF offsets, EARLY startup/drain; compile current/control/NT32ST5FL52 before any GPU request. Report actual registers/occupancy: the exiting WG does NOT by itself prove two CTAs/SM.
candidates.falsifier: One-WG longer compute chain outweighs zero/reduce removal, resource occupancy deteriorates, actual single-main output/JIT/probe gates fail, or it loses the current complete o32 route. Keep a positive0.1us result even if below old status thresholds.
candidates.new_proof: No forced serving pick. Mechanism arms may be labelled explicitly, but shipping comparison must call untouched PW38.kernel_fn and candidate actual prepare. No claim this helps actual RQ16.
